At 10 bar(a), ammonia boils at about 24.9 °C (298.06 K), and its latent heat of vaporisation there is **about 1166 kJ/kg** (h_vap − h_liq = 1166.2 kJ/kg). That is roughly 19.9 kJ/mol, using M = 17.03 g/mol.

I computed this with CoolProp (Helmholtz equation of state for ammonia) rather than recalling it. CoolProp also gives 1165.8 kJ/kg at 25 °C, where the saturation pressure is 10.03 bar, so the value at 10 bar is consistent. I did not check it against a printed steam/refrigerant table, but standard ammonia tables list about 1166 kJ/kg at 25 °C, which agrees.
